methods.retrieval: Downloaded the official e-Stat table PDF and saved the collection HTML and current terms-of-use HTML snapshots; byte lengths and SHA-256 values are recorded.
methods.inspection: Rendered the scanned PDF at high resolution and visually reviewed the page. Text extraction returned no usable text; OCR was not used as a numeric authority. One national row was transcribed and checked arithmetically.
methods.territorial_scope: The table is organized as a national total plus source-era prefectures. The table's inclusion/territorial notes were not established from this single scanned page; no claim is made about modern Japan's extent or equivalence, nor are individual places mapped to atlas territories.
methods.uncertainty: Only the observation year is evidenced in the e-Stat table listing; the exact census day and source population universe are not established here. The scan's numbers are visually legible for the national example, but no independent transcription or coverage/undercount assessment was performed.
